source_signature.notes: Batch 4H skill 1/4 (four-skill exception). Scope Operator-derived. Owns the internal-force SIGN CONVENTION itself, distinct from the computation specializations: declaring a consistent positive sense for N/V/M, interpreting a negative result as the opposite physical sense on the chosen face, the equal-and-opposite relationship between opposite cut faces, reporting SIGNED internal loadings (not bare magnitudes), and reconciling the same internal state solved from either segment. The signed specializations shear_force_internal_loading, bending_moment_internal_loading, normal_force_internal_loading own the actual V/M/N computation and are CITED as equation sources, not re-taught. Does not own diagram construction, dV/dx or dM/dx relations, stress, or deflection. Worked example Operator-re-derived (source-locked to the on-disk prompt; no inclined vector, trig cross-check N/A): SS 6 m beam, P=30 kN at 2 m, Ay=20/By=10 given; convention N+/tension, V+/upward-on-left-face, M+/sagging-CCW-on-left-face; cut at x=4 m. Left portion: SigmaFy Ay-P-V=0 -> V=-10 kN (NEGATIVE under the convention = 10 kN downward on the left face); SigmaM about the cut M-Ay(4)+P(2)=0 -> M=+20 kN·m (sagging). Two resultants shown; the negative V is the mandated at-least-one-negative result; a magnitude-only answer (V=10, M=20) is explicitly rejected as incomplete. Opposite faces equal-and-opposite: left face V=10 down/M=20 CCW pairs with right face V=10 up/M=20 CW. Right-segment reconciliation closes: By-V_rightface = 10-10 = 0 and By(2)-20 = 0 - same internal state from both segments. The distinguishing feature (the convention makes the answer signed and face/segment-consistent, not a bare magnitude) is decisive throughout. TWO-signal mapping: sign_or_placement_error at step 6 (CENTRAL - correct magnitude but wrong sense/face under the declared convention, or treating opposite-face resultants as same-sense), unclassified at step 8 (missing convention declaration, magnitude-only report, or skipped reconciliation). axis_confusion OMITTED: a convention skill with no inclined-load/component-resolution step - genuine omission, no axis assignment authored. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED: no order dependency that strands an unknown. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Opens Batch 4H.
